notes.title: CTHULOOT - 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello looters!
We are continuing our series of bug fixes.

Features

- Tweaked sounds, musics, volumes.
(Please support the awesome of Corentin Brasart: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3655300/CTHULOOT_Soundtrack/)

Bugs

- Fixed gem not visible in level 11 room 17
- Fix players not attached to controlled ship platforms
- Fix save data erased because we were not taking the best score 
- Fix achievement "A Place to Be" (you may have to swap with another character in the hub to trigger it)


Highlight

Some awesome videos/content of the game this week:

notes.title: CTHULOOT - 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello looters!
First patch post-release, yeeha!

Features

- Rework the second encounter of the fish boss: you can now throw bombs directly at it
- Updated credits

Bugs

- Fix typos in french
- Fix wrong button displayed in tutorial
- Fix watches not usable
- Fix missing shader on Steam deck
- Fix missing tile in the lair
- Fix fish boss splashes 
- Fix arrowed platform getting stuck in walls
- Fix platforms sound not being clean in Pirates env

--

Many thanks to all our early players and content creators <3
Your support is invaluable!

Have fun playing

notes.title: Demo update: progression saved and release date changed to April 14!
notes.content:
Hello Cthulooters,

Due to other announcements and an opportunity, we've postponed the game's release by a few days, to Monday afternoon, April 14.

We hope you're not too disappointed. 

If you're from the press or a content creator, you can e-mail us for a key to the game at cthuloot@pixelnest.io.

Cheers,
CTHULOOT dev team

notes.title: THE CTHULOOT DEMO IS AVAILABLE, PLAY IT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello Cthulooters, we are happy to present you the first playable demo of our game CTHULOOT.

Play with your friends and discover the demo content:


 4 characters (+1 unlockable)
 4 levels
 2 biomes: the Underworld Crypt & the Haunted Cove
 30+ rooms filled with traps and puzzles
 30+ items and mechanisms to combine
 1 hour of gameplay


Follow our tiny dev team:


 On Discord
 On X


We're really excited to show you what we've been cooking. We hope you're just as excited.
